payload.name: Habit Sequencing After an Existing Routine
payload.fact: Sequencing a new habit immediately after an existing routine step, rather than before it, promotes stronger formation of the new habit.
payload.boundary: Evidence is from a single dental-flossing-after-brushing intervention study; the general sequencing principle beyond dental flossing specifically is an inference from that one study, not independently replicated.

provenance.title: Forming a flossing habit: An exploratory study of the psychological determinants of habit formation
provenance.quote_or_locus: Initiating flossing after rather than before tooth-brushing promoted stronger habits

payload.grade_basis: Mechanical single-source grade cap (owner rule, 2026-08-10): 1 source -> C+ max, 2 sources -> B- max, 3+ independent sources -> B max, A band only with a meta-analysis or replication in the cited set. Computed grading does not exist yet; this is the interim mechanical floor. This claim: 1 independent source(s), original model-asserted grade A -> capped to C+.
